newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares end softer on profit-taking, results.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares end softer on profit-taking, results.

text.p: After rallying more than three percent last week, Chilean shares closed lower in a bout of profit-taking ahead of the release of company second quarter results, said traders.
The market is seen holding steady on coming sessions as attention focuses on the earnings figures, they said.
"I expect stocks to move sideways and only if there's a big earnings surprise, will the IPSA break through 137 points," said one broker.
The 40-share index closed unofficially down 1.15 percent at 133.06 points.
